spec.query: SELECT last("bid") FROM "default"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)
SELECT mean("pnl") FROM "retain_30_days"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "strategy" fill(none)

spec.title: Selini Strategies — Trading PnL Decomposition (Reset-Immune)
spec.description: One row per strategy. Trading PnL = Total PnL − Positional PnL, where Positional PnL = qty_at(start) × (mid_at(end) − mid_at(start)). Total PnL is computed per (strategy, mimid_start_time) session and summed, making it immune to mid-session resets. Mid uses bid as proxy. Footer = totals across selected strategies.

spec.query: SELECT SUM(segment_pnl) AS segment_pnl FROM (SELECT last("pnl") - first("pnl") AS segment_pnl FROM "strategy_pnl_summary" WHERE ("strategy"::tag =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"::tag, "mimid_start_time"::tag) GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT first("positionAsFloat") AS qty_open FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT first("bid") AS px_open FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND "bid" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"
SELECT last("bid") AS px_close FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND "bid" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "strategy"
